BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Marshall, Schmidt, Jacobsen, Barkis, Rude, Shavers, McClintock, and Couture
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Exempting schools and school districts from retail sales and use tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting schools and school districts from retail sales and use tax; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and creating a new section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales made to a school or a school district.

(2) For purposes of this section "school" means a public or private school, educational institution, or educational program that provides instruction to kindergarten through grade 12 students, regardless of whether a grade level is assigned or whether the program is designated elementary or secondary.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) This chapter does not apply to the use of personal property by a school or school district.

(2) For purposes of this section "school" means a public or private school, educational institution, or educational program that provides instruction to kindergarten through grade 12 students, regardless of whether a grade level is assigned or whether the program is designated elementary or secondary.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 82.32.805 and 82.32.808 do not apply to this act.
